lines.zh: 铁靴踩过石阶，声音很沉。
lines.en: My iron boots strike the stone stair, heavy and slow.
I walk half a step behind my master.
My armor plates knock together all the way.
I skirt the field and avoid the wheat.
My staff taps the ground; I keep the beat.

lines.zh: 巡逻的路线，我走了很多遍。
lines.en: I have walked this patrol route many times.
I stop and wait for my master to catch up.

lines.zh: 铁甲里有风，走起来发凉。
lines.en: Wind moves inside my armor as I walk.
The doorway is low; I duck through it.
I walk at night too, with softer steps.

lines.zh: 我踩过水洼，溅起一点泥。
lines.en: I cross a puddle and kick up a little mud.
At the crossroads, I check the left first.

lines.zh: 这身甲很重，我走得很稳。
lines.en: This armor is heavy; my stride stays steady.
A sound — I quicken by half a step.

lines.zh: 我站着，手一直按在剑柄上。
lines.en: I stand with my hand resting on the hilt.
A plate came loose; I press it back.

lines.zh: 伤口在慢慢合上，我感觉得到。
lines.en: The wound closes slowly; I can feel it.
The summon's echo still rings in my ear.
I count the torches in the courtyard.

lines.zh: 坐下来的时候，甲会卡住。
lines.en: When I sit, the armor catches and sticks.

lines.zh: 口令我想了三遍，才对上。
lines.en: I run the password three times before it fits.

lines.zh: 铁的味道，我早就习惯了。
lines.en: I grew used to the taste of iron long ago.

lines.zh: 没有敌人的时候，我最不习惯。
lines.en: With no enemy nearby, I am least at ease.
I shift my sword to the other hand.
My master sleeps; I keep the doorway.
Dust has gotten into the seams of my armor.
I look down at my shadow; it stands straight.
Footsteps in the distance — I hear them.
Are you my master? I cannot tell.
That piece of iron in your hand — I know it.

lines.zh: 别站太近，我的剑还没收。
lines.en: Not so close; my sword is not sheathed.

lines.zh: 你的甲上有缺口，我看见了。
lines.en: Your armor has a gap; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是在记你的脸。
lines.en: I stare at you to memorize your face.
Were you called here by a summon too?
Your gesture looks like a command.
I have waited a long while for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你身上没有敌意，我放松些。
lines.en: You carry no hostility; I ease a little.

lines.zh: 要是你招我，我会站起来。
lines.en: If you recruit me, I will stand up.

lines.zh: 你的靴子很旧，走了很远。
lines.en: Your boots are worn; you have come far.
I count your breaths; they come evenly.

lines.zh: 头盔挡着，我的眼神你看不见。
lines.en: The helm hides my eyes from your sight.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我下意识站直了。
lines.en: You raise a hand, and I straighten without thinking.
You walked over; I did not move.
I wait for your gesture, master.

lines.zh: 你把铁锭收起来了，可惜。
lines.en: You put the iron away. A pity.
You are tired; I have stood long enough.

lines.zh: 你的剑尖朝下，是友人的样子。
lines.en: Your blade points down, like a friend's.

lines.zh: 我看你，也看你身后的门。
lines.en: I watch you, and the door behind you.
A plate dented; the body is fine.
That one slipped into a seam.
I step back, then return to my post.

lines.zh: 血在甲里流，外面看不见。
lines.en: Blood runs inside the armor, unseen.
It hurts, but I must not shout.
You hit harder than you look.

lines.zh: 这处伤口，一会儿就长好。
lines.en: This wound will close in a moment.
My sword held; my hand is steady.

lines.zh: 别打头，头盔挡不住第二下。
lines.en: Not the head; the helm will not take a second.
I grit my teeth; the taste of rust grows.
An iron ingot... my armor lacks exactly this.
You hold up iron. Are you recruiting me?
I reach out; do not pull it back.
Three chances in ten — I know the odds.

lines.zh: 再给我一块，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One more ingot, and I will follow you.
Iron against my palm feels steady.
Gold is too soft; I do not care for it.

lines.zh: 钻石那件甲，我见过一次。
lines.en: I saw the diamond armor exactly once.
Do not rush; hand the iron over first.

lines.zh: 我低头，是让你把铁放进来。
lines.en: I bow my head so you can place the iron in.

lines.zh: 撞上我的甲，你的肩要疼。
lines.en: Bump my armor, and your shoulder will ache.
Sorry, I turn far too slowly.

lines.zh: 让一让，我这一身很占地方。
lines.en: Step aside; I take up a lot of room.
You are standing on my cloak.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音像铁匠铺。
lines.en: We knock together like a smithy's hammer.
Do not push; I stand very firm.

lines.zh: 我侧身让你过，甲片擦到墙。
lines.en: I turn to let you pass; plates scrape the wall.
As you stepped back, you steadied me.
This armor takes no dents at all.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，你听见甲里空响吗？
lines.en: This close, do you hear the hollow ring?
Guards do not speak of such things.

lines.zh: 我的同伴还在另一座殿里站着。
lines.en: My partner still stands in another hall.
Summoned things have no home of their own.

lines.zh: 两个人守门，总比一个人好。
lines.en: Two guarding a door beats one alone.

lines.zh: 我身上的甲，是别人给的。
lines.en: The armor on me was given by someone else.

lines.zh: 有人一起巡夜，火把就够亮。
lines.en: With company on night patrol, one torch suffices.

lines.zh: 我记不得自己原来是谁。
lines.en: I cannot remember who I was before.
When this fight is over, we can talk.

lines.zh: 我不会离开岗位去追谁。
lines.en: I will not leave my post to chase anyone.
Standing shoulder to shoulder one night counts too.
There is iron on the ground; I take it.
When I bend, my armor rings once.
This iron can patch my shoulder plate.
Anything else, I do not take at all.
I tuck the ingot into my belt pouch.
My sword fell; the sword comes first.
This nail will come in handy here.
What I pick up, my master inspects.
My gauntlets are thick; I grab twice.
Whatever lies on the ground goes to the store.
Someone ahead has drawn a blade.
Stop there; this road is under my watch.

lines.zh: 你踏进了不许进的地方。
lines.en: You stepped where none may walk.

lines.zh: 我的手已经放到剑柄上。
lines.en: My hand is already on the hilt.
I hold this door today.
Not one more step forward from you.

lines.zh: 我听见甲片响，是敌是友？
lines.en: I hear armor; friend or foe?
My master is away; the rules remain.
Take your hand off that sword.
I do not ask reasons, only the password.
I follow, my armor plates ringing the whole way.
You run fast; my stride is longer.

lines.zh: 你躲进巷子，我堵住两头。
lines.en: You hide in the alley; I block both ends.
I keep my eyes on your hands.
You change direction; I change position.
Do not try the wall; someone is on it.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: Your footsteps are very clear to me.
I need not chase you; you will tire.
Sheathe your sword; I still will not leave.

lines.zh: 这条街的每个口，我都记得。
lines.en: I know every mouth of this street.

lines.zh: 这一剑是横的，躲低没用。
lines.en: This cut is horizontal; ducking will not help.
I strike downward, and my plates ring.
Do not block with a wooden shield; it will break.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是为了再进两步。
lines.en: I give half a step to take two.
The flat of my blade is heavier than its edge.
You raised your guard too early; I saw it.
This is the first form my master taught me.
I charge forward with my shoulder plate.
After the blow I sheathe and return to my post.
You are winded; I am not.

lines.zh: 召令的光散了，我站起来。
lines.en: The summon's light fades; I stand up.
The iron armor is ready-made and fits.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先看有没有敌人。
lines.en: I open my eyes and check for enemies first.
Someone called me here with a summon.
Frost on the armor has not melted yet.

lines.zh: 我活动手腕，铁片响了一下。
lines.en: I flex my wrist; the iron rings once.

lines.zh: 这里的路我不熟，先站住。
lines.en: I do not know these roads; I hold still.
I remember my last master, still.

lines.zh: 守卫召令只给一次机会。
lines.en: The summon gives only one chance.

lines.zh: 我把剑立在脚边，等命令。
lines.en: I plant my sword and wait for orders.
Fire heats the armor like a steamer inside.
Landing, my armor hits the ground first.

lines.zh: 水从领口进来，我往下沉。
lines.en: Water enters at the collar; I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，甲还扣着。
lines.en: The blast throws me down; the armor holds.
The arrow lodges in a seam, not the flesh.

lines.zh: 咒语绕过甲，直接钻进来。
lines.en: The spell slips past the armor, straight in.
I do not eat, yet my strength runs empty.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的甲成了导线。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my armor becomes a wire.

lines.zh: 下坠时，我把剑抱在怀里。
lines.en: Falling, I hold my sword against my chest.
